note_sections.hpi: Mrs. Castellano is a 73-year-old female returning 14 days after left 2nd digit proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint arthroplasty for hammertoe correction. She reports mild residual swelling and pain 3...

auto_coding_summary: Established post-op follow-up (Day 14 of 90-day global) after left 2nd toe PIP joint arthroplasty for hammertoe correction. Coded with Z48.89 (primary aftercare), M20.42 (left hammer toe), and M81.0 (age-related osteoporosis) — all Assessment anchors. CPT 99024 reports the non-billable global post-op visit. Post-op X-ray and prophylactic Cephalexin are bundled in the surgical global package. PMH GERD and hypothyroidism remain in supporting_conditions only. SNOMED set cleaned by removing an incorrect skin-eruption mapping; one low-confidence anatomy concept flagged for review. No additional CPT, HCPCS, or modifiers required.
